subject: FinTrust — incident notification, requested IR artifacts & retention question
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintrust.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: 2028-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Suspicious auth failures observed — asking for quick artifacts and IRP

Hi Sofia / Neha,

We detected a short window (2028-05-10 15:03–15:11 UTC) where a subset of token refresh requests returned 500s and a small percentage of sessions dropped. FinTrust security has collected trace headers and a sample log slice — attached as fintrust-observed-headers.txt.

Request: can you confirm this was not customer-data exfiltration and provide the following items for our review by EOD Monday 2028-05-12:
- Incident response runbook (IRP) version and point-of-contact for on-call
- A 24h log extract for the affected tenant (redacted if needed) and a checksum/list of files exported
- Retention policy for auth logs and any audit trails (how long raw logs retained)

We appreciate a short timeline and whether you need a formal NDA/POC for log transfer.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Security Ops | FinTrust Bank
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious auth failures observed — asking for quick artifacts and IRP

Daniel — thanks for the heads up and for sending the header sample. We're looking into the traffic now. Quick answers up front:
- We will provide the current IRP (internal runbook) and the point-of-contact for the on-call responder.
- We can produce a log extract. We need to confirm the exact tenant identifier to avoid over-sharing; can you confirm the tenant ID you observed?
- Our auth logs are retained for 90 days in raw form and 2 years as compressed indices; I will attach the retention policy doc and a short mapping.

Planned cadence: we will assemble an artifacts bundle (redacted where applicable) and an initial timeline; target to upload to a secure S3 snapshot and share a link by 2028-05-12 18:00 UTC. If FinTrust requires PII redaction beyond standard hashes, please let us know now so we can route to Legal.

I'll loop Marissa (for evidence packaging) and Karthik (for timeline/forensics).

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious auth failures observed — artifacts we will provide

Daniel / team — thanks, we're assembling the bundle. Preliminary artifact list (will be uploaded as a tarball):
- log_export_20280510.tar.gz (auth service logs for suspected window, gzip compressed)
- s3-access-snapshot.json (manifest of objects exported and checksums)
- postmortem-draft.docx (initial timeline + impacted routes)
- runbook_v3.2.pdf (current IRP runbook, internal)

Notes/asks:
- Please confirm the tenant id: FT-5589? If different, we will narrow the extract.
- FinTrust prefers CSP-provided transfer vs. third-party; we will provision a pre-signed, time-limited S3 link over TLS.
- If you need logs with payloads (not just metadata), we require a signed data handling attestation — Legal to confirm.

Forwarding the proposed upload plan: we will stage artifacts to an internal bucket, perform redaction (PII hashes only), run a checksum, and share a single download link with expiry and MFA. Expected upload timestamp: 2028-05-12T17:30:00Z.

On Thu, May 10, 2028 at 09:12, Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintrust.com> wrote:
> We detected a short window (2028-05-10 15:03–15:11 UTC) where a subset of token refresh requests returned 500s and a small percentage of sessions dropped.
>
> Request: can you confirm this was not customer-data exfiltration and provide the following items for our review by EOD Monday 2028-05-12: IRP, 24h log extract, retention policy.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintrust.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, security@fintrust.com
Date: 2028-05-12T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious auth failures observed — artifacts we will provide

Team — appreciate the rapid response and the artifact list. FT-5589 is the correct tenant id. A few follow-ups before we close the loop:
- The FinTrust SOC wants confirmation you ran the IR tabletop exercise in Q1 2028; can you confirm the date and POC who ran it?
- We will accept the S3 pre-signed link and the redacted extracts. Please include the checksum file and a short guide for verifying integrity.
- If your Legal requires an NDA for full payload logs, please escalate; otherwise hashed payloads are fine for now.

If you can confirm the tabletop date and attach the runbook with the on-call POC in the bundle, FinTrust will consider this a closed notification and will not open a formal escalated audit.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Security Ops | FinTrust Bank

--
Attachments referenced: fintrust-observed-headers.txt
